atacama.name: Atacama / northern Chile
atacama.rationale: Original development example, not held out.

haughton.name: Haughton Crater
haughton.rationale: Original development example, not held out.

deathvalley.name: Death Valley / Badwater vicinity
deathvalley.rationale: Original development example, not held out.

namib.name: Namib dune desert
namib.rationale: Dune desert; test whether broad bare/dry screening admits dunes despite surface hazards.

sahara.name: Central Sahara
sahara.rationale: Hot arid desert; new hot/dry candidate.

wadi_rum.name: Wadi Rum / southern Jordan
wadi_rum.rationale: Arid rocky desert; relief should expose limitations of mean-slope screening.

uyuni.name: Salar de Uyuni
uyuni.rationale: High-altitude salt flat and surrounding mountains; not necessarily hot.

outback.name: Central Australian desert
outback.rationale: Hot dry interior; land-cover classification may be sparse vegetation rather than barren.

gobi.name: Gobi desert
gobi.rationale: Dry continental desert with cold winters; cold alone should not imply permafrost.

axel_heiberg.name: Axel Heiberg Island
axel_heiberg.rationale: Independent High Arctic patch; includes rock, ice and coastal water.

svalbard.name: Central Svalbard
svalbard.rationale: Arctic bare/permafrost terrain; maritime winter threshold may reject it.

iceland.name: Central Iceland
iceland.rationale: Volcanic bare terrain with wetter/milder climate; visually plausible analog that broad climate filters may reject.

amazon.name: Amazon / Manaus vicinity
amazon.rationale: Warm wet tropical forest; should fail dry/bare filters.

borneo.name: Central Borneo
borneo.rationale: Warm wet tropical forest and mountain context.

finland.name: Finnish Lapland
finland.rationale: Cold forested terrain; should not be classified as bare polar desert.

iowa.name: Central Iowa
iowa.rationale: Temperate agricultural landscape; hot summers alone should not suffice.

serengeti.name: Serengeti region
serengeti.rationale: Warm seasonal savanna; sparse tree cover alone should not count as barren.

mekong.name: Mekong Delta
mekong.rationale: Warm wet low-slope agriculture and water; tests flat/hot confounders.

tokyo.name: Tokyo region
tokyo.rationale: Warm built-up/coastal landscape; tests hot urban surface confounders.

alps.name: Central Alps
alps.rationale: Cold rocky mountainous terrain with ice; tests steep/wet confounders.

himalaya.name: Everest / central Himalaya
himalaya.rationale: Very high rocky/icy mountains; cold bare areas need not provide a low-slope usable footprint.

greenland.name: Greenland interior ice sheet
greenland.rationale: Cold dry ice sheet; should fail the bare-ground requirement.

pacific.name: Equatorial central Pacific
pacific.rationale: Open ocean; missing land-cover coverage must not become a barren zero.

antarctica.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys vicinity
antarctica.rationale: Plausible cold-desert setting outside EarthEnv terrain and northern permafrost domains; expected data-driven rejection, not evidence of unsuitability.

almeria.name: Almeria / southeast Spain
almeria.rationale: Semiarid region with agriculture, coast and hills; tests threshold boundaries and mixed landscapes.

benchmarks.scope: Count queries via the existing wide raster view, fresh local connections, reader role, 10-second statement limit. Three sequential samples per size/profile; warm-cache order, not a production latency distribution.

limits: Purposive small environmental sample; not global precision/recall or certified analog labels.
Pixel connectivity on 1km mean values does not establish traversability at finer scales.
Missing required measurements reject eligibility and are reported separately from observed threshold failures.
Geology and relief are imported context; frozen queries do not test their discriminating power.
